name: حساب متوسط الاعداد الصحيحة المدخلة والتي تكون زوجية
description: انشئ برنامجاً يقرأ سلسلة من القيم الصحيحة من المستخدم، يجمع الأعداد الصحيحة التي تكون زوجية، ويحسب متوسطها. يدخل المستخدم 0 للدلالة على نهاية الادخال.
code:
#Khatwa 1: Taayyin qiyam ibtida'iya lilmutaghayyirat allati nahtaajuha li hadha albarnamij
total = 0
count = 0
#Khatwa 2: Qira'at awwal adad sahih yadkhuluhu almustakhdim
text = input("Adkhil rakman sahihan (0 lilkhurooj): ")
num = int(text)
#Khatwa 3: Aamil ala al'adad alladhi adkhalahu almustakhdim, thumma istaqbil wa aamil ala al'a'dad altaaliya ma duma annal mudkhul ghair sifr; itha kana sifr, fa tawqaf
while num != 0 :
    if num % 2 == 0 :
        count += 1
        total += num
    print("Majmu al-aadad al-zawiya hatta al-aan huwa", total, ", add al-aadad al-zawiya =", count)
    text = input("Adkhil rakman sahihan (0 lilkhurooj): ")
    num = int(text)
#Khatwa 4: Ihsib wa atbaa mutawassit al'a'dad al-zawiya allathee adkhalaha almustakhdim
if count == 0 :
    print("Lam yadkhul ay adad zawiya.")
else :
    average = total / count
print("Al-mutawassit huwa:", average)

untr_name: Calculating the Average of the Input Integers that are an Even Number
untr_description: Construct a program that reads a series of integer values from the user, sums up the integers that are an even number, and calculate their average. The user enters 0 to indicate the end of the input.
untr_code:
#Step 1: Assign initial values to the variables which we need for this program
total = 0
count = 0
#Step 2: Read the first integer that the user enters
text = input("Enter an integer (0 to quit): ")
num = int(text)
#Step 3: Process the integer that the user has entered, then receive and process the next integers as long as the user enters a non-zero integer; otherwise stop
